stemMarkdown: How many students play exactly two of the three sports?
solutionMarkdown:
Each pairwise figure includes the 10 who play all three, so subtract them from each:

- cricket and football only: $30 - 10 = 20$
- football and tennis only: $25 - 10 = 15$
- cricket and tennis only: $20 - 10 = 10$

$20 + 15 + 10 = 45$

**45 students**. Adding the three pairwise figures to 75 and stopping there is the standard error — it triple-counts the centre.
